result.instructions: Tools for Evenium, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my upcoming Evenium events."; "Who has not answered the invitation to event 12458?"; "Confirm guest 1102365 at event 12458.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Evenium data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run evenium_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run evenium_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run evenium_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. evenium_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: evenium_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the events of the Evenium account, with id, title, dates, status and creation date. Filter by title (partial match), status and start/end/creation dates. Use an event id with the guest and session tools. GET /events.

title.description: Events whose title is like this text.

status.description: FUTURE = open, DRAFT, CLOSED, ARCHIVED, CANCELED, DELETED, CLONEABLE = template.

starts_after.description: RFC 3339 date or date-time, UTC preferred, e.g. 2026-10-01Z or 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z (without a timezone Evenium uses Central European Time).

starts_before.description: RFC 3339 date or date-time, UTC preferred, e.g. 2026-10-01Z or 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z (without a timezone Evenium uses Central European Time).

created_before.description: RFC 3339 date or date-time, UTC preferred, e.g. 2026-10-01Z or 2026-10-01T09:00:00Z (without a timezone Evenium uses Central European Time).

tools.name: evenium_get_event
tools.title: Get event
tools.description: One event by id: title, description, dates, status, site path and its fields (type, your external id, ...). GET /events/{eventId}.

event_id.description: Evenium event id (e.g. 12458), or `ext:<your own event id>` (the EXT_EVENT_ID field).

tools.name: evenium_list_guests
tools.title: List guests
tools.description: List the guests (invited contacts) of an event with name, email, company, registration status (e.g. CONFIRMED, DECLINED, UNANSWERED), category and fields. Filter by status, name, email, company or last update. GET /events/{eventId}/guests.

event_id.description: Evenium event id (e.g. 12458), or `ext:<your own event id>` (the EXT_EVENT_ID field).

status.description: Only guests with exactly this registration status.

updated_since.description: Only guests updated after this date (RFC 3339).

updated_until.description: Only guests updated until this date (RFC 3339).

first_result.description: Index of the first result, from 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_first_result.

tools.name: evenium_get_guest
tools.title: Get guest
tools.description: One guest of an event, by contact id or by guest code: name, email, status, category and fields (event-only fields flagged). Optionally include REGISTRATION (registrations to sessions), PRESENCE and SIGNATURE data. GET /events/{eventId}/guests/{contactId} or /guests/guestCode/{guestCode}.

event_id.description: Evenium event id (e.g. 12458), or `ext:<your own event id>` (the EXT_EVENT_ID field).

contact_id.description: The guest's contact id. Give this or guest_code.

guest_code.description: The guest's code at the event (e.g. D4571). Give this or contact_id.

tools.name: evenium_get_guest_status
tools.title: Get guest status
tools.description: The registration status of one guest at an event (e.g. CONFIRMED, DECLINED, CANCELED). GET /events/{eventId}/guests/{contactId}/status.

event_id.description: Evenium event id (e.g. 12458), or `ext:<your own event id>` (the EXT_EVENT_ID field).

contact_id.description: Evenium contact id (e.g. 1102365; the guest's contactId), or `ext:<your own customId>`.

tools.name: evenium_get_guest_post_status
tools.title: Get guest attendance
tools.description: The attendance (post) status of one guest after the event: UNKNOWN, NO_SHOW or PRESENT. GET /events/{eventId}/guests/{contactId}/postStatus.

event_id.description: Evenium event id (e.g. 12458), or `ext:<your own event id>` (the EXT_EVENT_ID field).

contact_id.description: Evenium contact id (e.g. 1102365; the guest's contactId), or `ext:<your own customId>`.

tools.name: evenium_get_guest_accommodations
tools.title: Get guest accommodations
tools.description: The hotel room bookings of one guest at an event: room id, check-in and check-out dates, status. Not available on the evenium.net platform. GET /events/{eventId}/guests/{contactId}/accommodations.

event_id.description: Evenium event id (e.g. 12458), or `ext:<your own event id>` (the EXT_EVENT_ID field).

contact_id.description: Evenium contact id (e.g. 1102365; the guest's contactId), or `ext:<your own customId>`.

tools.name: evenium_list_hotels
tools.title: List hotels
tools.description: The hotels of an event with name, group, stars, contact details and, if asked, full location and rooms. Not available on the evenium.net platform. GET /events/{eventId}/hotels.

event_id.description: Evenium event id (e.g. 12458), or `ext:<your own event id>` (the EXT_EVENT_ID field).

include.description: Extra hotel properties: location (full address), rooms (room list).

tools.name: evenium_create_guest
tools.title: Create guest
tools.description: WRITE: invite a person to an event. Either invite an existing contact (contact_id) or create a guest from scratch (first_name, last_name, email, ...), which may also create a new contact. The optional status sets the registration status (the invitation emails of the event may follow Evenium's own rules). POST /events/{eventId}/guests.

event_id.description: Evenium event id (e.g. 12458), or `ext:<your own event id>` (the EXT_EVENT_ID field).

contact_id.description: Evenium contact id of an existing contact to invite. If set, the name fields are ignored.

status.description: Registration status to give the guest (default chosen by Evenium).

tools.name: evenium_update_guest_status
tools.title: Update guest status
tools.description: WRITE: set the registration status of a guest at an event (e.g. CONFIRMED, DECLINED, CANCELED). Can trigger Evenium's own workflows for that status. Read the current value first with evenium_get_guest_status. PUT /events/{eventId}/guests/{contactId}/status.

event_id.description: Evenium event id (e.g. 12458), or `ext:<your own event id>` (the EXT_EVENT_ID field).

contact_id.description: Evenium contact id (e.g. 1102365; the guest's contactId), or `ext:<your own customId>`.

tools.name: evenium_update_guest_post_status
tools.title: Update guest attendance
tools.description: WRITE: set the attendance (post) status of a guest: PRESENT, NO_SHOW or UNKNOWN (for example after check-in). PUT /events/{eventId}/guests/{contactId}/postStatus.

event_id.description: Evenium event id (e.g. 12458), or `ext:<your own event id>` (the EXT_EVENT_ID field).

contact_id.description: Evenium contact id (e.g. 1102365; the guest's contactId), or `ext:<your own customId>`.

tools.name: evenium_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact to the address book (name, email, company, optional custom id and fields). Does not invite them to an event (use evenium_create_guest). May create a duplicate of an existing person: search with evenium_list_contacts first. POST /contacts.

custom_id.description: Your own id for this contact (later usable as `ext:<id>`).

fields.description: Extra contact fields as {name, value} pairs.

name.description: Field name, e.g. FUNCTION, MOBILE_PHONE_NUMBER, ADDR_CITY, or a numeric custom-field code.

tools.name: evenium_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change a contact's email, company or fields (only what you pass is sent). The change applies to the contact everywhere, including its guest records. PUT /contacts/{contactId}.

contact_id.description: Evenium contact id (e.g. 1102365; the guest's contactId), or `ext:<your own customId>`.

fields.description: Extra contact fields as {name, value} pairs.

name.description: Field name, e.g. FUNCTION, MOBILE_PHONE_NUMBER, ADDR_CITY, or a numeric custom-field code.
